thread:
sara (Billing): FYI — batch invoice job 2026-03-22-03 produced ~12 customer PDFs with missing SKU line items for reserved capacity. customer example: ACME-889 invoice_id 20260322-ACME-77 has total but the 'Reserved GPU - dedicated' line is absent.

matt (Billing Eng): thanks, I'm on it. any duplicates reported too?

sara (Billing): yes — 3 customers received two PDFs with the same invoice_id but different line breakdowns.

kevin (SRE): tagging logs: job id invoice_job_20260322-03 processed 1,204 invoices. I see intermittent failures in the join to sku_mappings table around 03:14:05Z.

matt (Billing Eng): looks like a migration changed sku_mappings.primary_key from uuid -> id and the job still queries by uuid for some tenanted rows. quick snippet from the renderer logs: 

```
ERROR Renderer: sku lookup failed for customer_id=8924 sku_uuid=null
Trace: KeyError: 'sku_uuid'
sql: SELECT sku_name, sku_type FROM sku_mappings WHERE sku_uuid = 'f2a1...' AND tenant_id = 34;
```

julio (Payments): if we re-render we'll need to make sure we don't create duplicate invoice numbers. Is the invoice_id assignment upstream or during PDF render?

matt (Billing Eng): invoice_id assigned during billing-run (pre-render). The renderer only formats lines. Duplicate PDFs mean the requeue created a second PDF for same invoice_id. We need idempotent PDF generation.

finance-bot: Automated alert: invoice_job_20260322-03: 12 render errors, 3 duplicate pdf artifacts, 0 failed billing transfers.

ella (Accounting): we already had 2 customers flag payments reconciled incorrectly because the line item was missing (reserved capacity charge present in summary but not at line level). Right now GL mapping fails for those invoices.

sara (Billing): Action plan proposal: 1) fix renderer query to fallback to sku.id when sku_uuid is null; 2) backfill missing lines for affected invoices and re-render PDFs; 3) run dedupe pass to remove duplicate PDFs and re-emit one canonical copy; 4) notify affected customers. Anyone object?

kevin (SRE): +1. I can throttle the re-render queue so we don't hammer object storage. Also want a short maintenance window for the dedupe job.

matt (Billing Eng): working on patch now. tentative SQL change: 

```
-- use either sku_uuid or sku.id fallback
SELECT sku_name, sku_type
FROM sku_mappings
WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND (sku_uuid = $2 OR id = $3)
```

matt (Billing Eng): will open a PR and run unit tests against sample migr datasets. Planning to ship hotfix in ~45m if tests pass.

sara (Billing): I'll draft a customer note for accounting and support with affected invoice_ids and suggested reconciliations.

julio (Payments): For the three duplicate PDFs, please mark the extra files as superseded and ensure we don't send both to customers. I'll coordinate with support on outreach.

ella (Accounting): please include a CSV export of affected invoices (invoice_id, customer_id, net_amount, missing_line_description) so we can reconcile GL entries before customer outreach.

matt (Billing Eng): noted — adding a debug endpoint to export affected invoice payloads. temporary command to requeue renderer for invoice ids: 

```
./billing-tools requeue-render --invoices 20260322-ACME-77,20260322-ZEN-11 --dry-run
```

finance-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 15m.

sara (Billing): thanks all. I'll own customer comms and the reconciliation CSV. matt/kevin, pls post when hotfix is live and when the dedupe/re-render window is scheduled. :thumbsup:
